effects: The signer sends exactly `assets` USDC to the vault (safeTransferFrom caller -> vault), which supplies it to Morpho Blue.
The receiver gets vault shares (USDC RWA), amount = assets converted at the current share price, rounded down.
Before this, the vault mints fee shares to the fee recipient (_accrueFee); this dilutes holders but is not taken from the deposit.
formats.shown: Intent "Deposit"; 100 USDC as the deposit amount, a constant "Share ticker: USDC RWA", and the share receiver.

findings.title: deposit does not show how many USDC RWA shares the receiver gets; the share price sets it.
findings.evidence: MetaMorpho.deposit: `shares = _convertToSharesWithTotals(assets, totalSupply(), newTotalAssets, Math.Rounding.Floor);` No calldata value carries it. Case 0: signer received 96.474801327227199071 USDC RWA; screen shows only 'Share ticker: USDC RWA'.
findings.fix: None in the descriptor. ERC-4626 deposit has no minimum-shares parameter.

findings.title: deposit shows the share ticker as a separate raw field with no link to what the signer receives.
findings.evidence: descriptor deposit field `{"label": "Share ticker", "format": "raw", "value": "$.metadata.constants.vaultTicker"}`; intent "Deposit" names neither asset. Case 0 reader: 'USDC RWA shares ... amount not shown'.
findings.fix: Rename the label to "Receive vault shares" and change the intent to "Deposit USDC for USDC RWA shares".

cases.notes: 100 USDC out is shown with asset and amount. USDC RWA shares in: asset and receiver shown, amount (96.47) not.

effects: The signer sends USDC to the vault, amount = shares converted at the current share price, rounded up; no calldata value bounds it, only the signer's USDC allowance.
The receiver gets exactly `shares` USDC RWA vault shares.
Before this, the vault mints fee shares to the fee recipient (_accrueFee).
formats.shown: Intent "Mint"; "Deposit asset: USDC" with no amount, the exact shares minted, and the share receiver.

findings.title: mint does not show how much USDC leaves the signer; the share price sets it, with no bound.
findings.evidence: MetaMorpho.mint: `assets = _convertToAssetsWithTotals(shares, totalSupply(), newTotalAssets, Math.Rounding.Ceil); _deposit(_msgSender(), receiver, assets, shares);` ERC4626._deposit: `SafeERC20.safeTransferFrom(_asset, caller, address(this), assets);`. Case 1: signer sent 1 (wei) USDC; screen shows 'Deposit asset: USDC' only.
findings.fix: None in the descriptor: the amount comes from storage. ERC-4626 mint has no maximum-assets parameter.

findings.title: mint intent "Mint" does not say the signer pays USDC at the current share price.
findings.evidence: descriptor mint: `"intent": "Mint"`, field `{"label": "Deposit asset", "format": "raw", "value": "$.metadata.constants.underlyingTicker"}`. Case 1 reader unsure: 'How much USDC I am depositing; the screen doesn't say.'
findings.fix: Change the intent to "Pay USDC to mint vault shares" and the label to "Pay with (amount set by share price)".

cases.notes: USDC out: asset named, amount (1 wei) not shown. Shares go to 0xdEaD (signer null), shown correctly as receiver.

formats.key: withdraw(uint256 assets, address receiver, address owner)
effects: The vault burns USDC RWA shares from `owner`, amount = assets converted at the share price, rounded up.
When the signer is not the owner, the signer spends the owner's share allowance to the signer.
The receiver gets exactly `assets` USDC from the vault (pulled from Morpho Blue).
formats.shown: Intent "Withdraw"; exact USDC amount, the receiver, and the owner whose shares are used.

findings.title: withdraw does not show the USDC RWA shares burned from the owner; the share price sets the amount.
findings.evidence: MetaMorpho.withdraw: `shares = _convertToSharesWithTotals(assets, totalSupply(), newTotalAssets, Math.Rounding.Ceil);` ERC4626._withdraw: `_burn(owner, shares);`. Case 2: signer lost 49.190445202466200931 USDC RWA; no field names shares; reader 'leaves' is empty.
findings.fix: None for the amount. Optionally add a constant field "Burns USDC RWA shares from" next to Owner.

cases.notes: USDC RWA shares out: not shown; reader guessed position shrinks by ~50 USDC. USDC in 50.020219 to kugusha.eth (signer) shown right.

formats.key: redeem(uint256 shares, address receiver, address owner)
effects: The vault burns exactly `shares` USDC RWA from `owner`; when the signer is not the owner, it spends the owner's share allowance.
The receiver gets USDC, amount = shares converted at the share price, rounded down.
formats.shown: Intent "Redeem"; exact shares to redeem, the receiver, and the owner; nothing names the asset or amount received.

findings.title: redeem never names USDC as the asset the receiver gets back.
findings.evidence: ERC4626._withdraw: `SafeERC20.safeTransfer(_asset, receiver, assets);` with _asset = USDC (constructor arg). Descriptor redeem fields: shares, receiver, owner only; mint uses `$.metadata.constants.underlyingTicker` but redeem does not. Case 3: signer received 511802.315427 USDC; reader: 'Unknown amount and asset... likely USDC but not stated'.
findings.fix: Add `{"label": "Receive asset", "format": "raw", "value": "$.metadata.constants.underlyingTicker"}` and change the intent to "Redeem shares for USDC".

findings.title: redeem does not show the USDC amount received; the share price sets it.
findings.evidence: MetaMorpho.redeem: `assets = _convertToAssetsWithTotals(shares, totalSupply(), newTotalAssets, Math.Rounding.Floor);` Case 3: 511802.315427 USDC in, not on screen.
findings.fix: None in the descriptor. ERC-4626 redeem has no minimum-assets parameter.

cases.notes: Shares out shown and understood. USDC in: neither asset nor amount on screen; reader did not know what arrives.
